item.title: Tourmaline occurs in a remarkably wide range of colors
item.description:
GEMOLOGY FACT: Tourmaline includes blue, green, pink and red varieties; trade names such as rubellite refer to particular color ranges.
EXIMUTC view: Judge the stone's tone, transparency and inclusions individually; a trade name is not a quality grade.
Source: Gemological Institute of America https://www.gia.edu/gia-website/tourmaline-description
